content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum Matriculation / 10th pass from recognized educational institution; At least 05 days training from Agriculture and Horticulture Directorate; Knowledge of local language; Ability to ride bicycle and climb trees; Must be a permanent resident of Gumla district Age limit: Minimum 18 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Gumla district Must have knowledge of local language Must be able to ride a bicycle and climb trees Engagement is purely on honorarium/remuneration basis Desirable: Preference to candidates with training longer than 5 days under the Directorate of Agriculture or Horticulture, Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DAO Gumla Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications with incomplete details, missing certificates, or false information will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: DAO Gumla Crop Guard (Kamdar) Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected Crop Guards (Kamdar) will be required to perform the following field duties: Crop surveillance and survey work. Spraying of pesticides and plant protection chemicals. Assisting in farmer training and awareness programmes. Executing other official tasks assigned by the office from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged for one year or until regular appointments are made

content_sections.heading: How Will DAO Gumla Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications and documents Evaluation based on 100 marks total Preparation of merit list based on 10th percentage, training, bicycle/tree climbing test and interview Academic qualification (10th marks percentage x 0.6 = max 60 marks) Skill test (Bicycle riding and tree climbing = 10 marks) Interview (General Hindi, general knowledge and local language = 20 marks)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Matriculation/10th pass certificate and marksheet Minimum 05 days training certificate Local resident certificate issued by competent authority Caste certificate issued by competent authority if applicable Identity card / Aadhaar card copy

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DAO Gumla Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the notification. Fill the application form clearly in Hindi or English. Attach self-attested copies of required educational and supporting certificates. Submit the application by hand or through Registered / Speed Post to the office address. Make sure it reaches by 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications not accompanied by self-attested copies of required certificates will be rejected Original certificates will be verified at a later specified date

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DAO Gumla Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DAO Gumla Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies for Crop Guard (Kamdar).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DAO Gumla Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (PDF Pages 6-8) and send it to Office of the District Agriculture Officer, Gumla, Combined Agriculture Building Complex, Near Vikas Colony, Post-Gumla, District-Gumla, Pin-835207, by registered / speed post or by hand, to reach by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 11851 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum Matriculation / 10th pass with minimum 05 days training from Agriculture and Horticulture Directorate.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a permanent resident of Gumla district. Must have knowledge of local language. Must be able to ride a bicycle and climb trees. Engagement is purely on honorarium/remuneration basis.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications with incomplete details, missing certificates, or false information will be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications and documents. Evaluation based on 100 marks total. Preparation of merit list based on 10th percentage, training, bicycle/tree climbing test and interview. Academic qualification (10th marks percentage x 0.6 = max 60 marks).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be engaged for one year or until regular appointments are made.
